ns2:course.label: Algebraic Topology II
ns2:course.description: CW-complexes, relative homeomorphism theorem, cellular homology, cohomology, Kunneth theorem, Eilenberg-Zilber theorem, cup products, Poincare duality, examples. Prerequisite: MATH 525, MATH 500; or consent of instructor. MATH 501 is recommended but not required.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MATH 525, MATH 500; or consent of instructor. MATH 501 is recommended but not required.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MS:Economics:Policy Econ -UIUC or MS: Financial Engineering.
